## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl with a pale, delicate rose-leaf complexion, expressive gray eyes, and pointed features. Her hair, which was intensely red and thick in her childhood, darkens over time to a glossy auburn. She possesses a distinct, graceful carriage, and a face whose mobile features constantly reflect her inner emotions.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P37](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0037), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c27 P41](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0041), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)_

## Personality

Anne is an intensely imaginative, romantic, and passionate individual who experiences life with vibrant emotional intensity. Though quick-tempered and fiercely proud in her youth, she matures into a thoughtful, empathetic, and deeply loyal woman. She harbors a profound appreciation for nature's beauty and possesses an innate ability to inspire affection and joy in those around her. Always striving toward high ideals, she approaches life's difficulties with optimism and humor.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P5](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0005), [v1 c9 P18](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0018), [v1 c15 P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P25](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0025), [v2 c7 P17](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0017), [v2 c15 P44](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0044)_

## History

Anne Shirley arrives at Green Gables in Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, after siblings Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert decide to adopt an orphan boy but receive Anne by mistake. Though Marilla initially intends to send her back, Matthew's quiet fondness and Anne's passionate plea convince them to keep her. Anne grows up in Avonlea, making a soulmate friendship with Diana Barry, causing various humorous and disastrous scrapes due to her vivid imagination, and developing a fierce academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe after he calls her 'Carrots.' She attends Queen's Academy, earning her teacher's license and winning the Avery Scholarship. Following Matthew's sudden death from a heart attack and Marilla's failing eyesight, Anne waives her scholarship to stay at Green Gables, taking a local teaching job in Avonlea to support Marilla and help raise the orphaned Keith twins, Davy and Dora. During two years of teaching, she helps organize the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and reconciles her long-standing grudge against Gilbert, becoming close friends with him. Later, supported by an inheritance from Miss Josephine Barry, Anne attends Redmond College in Kingsport, earning her B.A. with High Honors in English. During her college years she lives at Patty's Place with her friends, receives and rejects a proposal from the handsome, wealthy Roy Gardner upon realizing she does not truly love him, and eventually realizes her deep, enduring love for Gilbert Blythe, accepting his proposal of marriage after he recovers from a dangerous bout of typhoid fever.

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to schoolteachers Walter and Bertha Shirley, who both died of fever when she was three months old  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised in poverty by Mrs. Thomas and later Mrs. Hammond, taking care of numerous children and twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Spent four months in the Hopeton orphan asylum before being mistakenly brought to Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
